Name: aggregation_operator_unspill_memory_limit
Description: How much memory should be allocated per aggregation operator in unspilling process

Name: max_partial_top_n_memory
Description: Max memory size for partial Top N aggregations. This can be turned off by setting it with '0'.

Name: task_concurrency
Description: Default number of local parallel jobs per worker

Name: iceberg.parquet_ignore_statistics
Description: Ignore statistics from Parquet to allow querying files with corrupted or incorrect statistics

Name: iceberg.parquet_max_read_block_row_count
Description: Parquet: Maximum number of rows read in a batch

Name: iceberg.parquet_max_read_block_size
Description: Parquet: Maximum size of a block to read

Name: iceberg.parquet_small_file_threshold
Description: Parquet: Size below which a parquet file will be read entirely

Name: iceberg.parquet_vectorized_decoding_enabled
Description: Enable using Java Vector API for faster decoding of parquet files

Name: iceberg.parquet_writer_batch_size
Description: Parquet: Maximum number of rows passed to the writer in each batch
